protocol.calibration: Same frozen baseline, 2 excluded fresh-process warmups then 3 AA pairs; each bench11 signature419798; 30s entire calibration; both external wall and process CPU median ratio0.95..1.05 and all0.85..1.15; otherwise no games/no retry.
protocol.aa: 4 serial color-swapped pairs, same baseline, 10000nodes tc=inf; exact deterministic normal paired games required; smoke runner has existing maxmoves200 safety limit; operational readiness only.
protocol.sprt: One uninterrupted 0,+5 logistic alpha=beta=.05 run, tc2+0.02, cap500pairs or16min wall. First48pairs are a prefix only; no gate/reset/retry/pooling/adjudication/maxmoves. Interrupted/faulted attempts cannot accept.
protocol.engine_options: Threads1 Hash32 OwnBookfalse MoveOverhead10 restarton; Ponderfalse is verified runtime default, not an explicit frozen-runner option.
protocol.scope: Native hosted Linux only; neither native Windows/Ryzen performance nor a claim of +5 Elo. H1 requires independently checked actual likelihood boundary. All capped/no-boundary attempts inconclusive.
protocol.preservation: Keep every original PGN/log and incomplete record without trimming; artifact upload and fresh results branch attempted always. Hard24min entire job. No retries.
protocol.fail_fast: Poll every0.5s during matches; any non-normal PGN Termination or console/log warning/error stops owned group, preserves raw, and prevents acceptance; no reset.

scope: Native hosted Linux only; no native Windows/Ryzen claim.
